name: Dispel Metal
body:
School abjuration [fire]; Level druid 5, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 5, shaman 5

This spell functions as dispel evil, except it surrounds you in a fiery aura and it affects creatures bearing metal weapons or armor and metal constructs, rather than evil ones. You cannot cast this spell if you are bearing metal.
